E=weights['shared.embed_tokens.weight']
fn=1+weights['shared.norm.weight']
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
ids=np.arange(1000,21000,4)  # 5000 tokens
Es=E[ids].astype(np.float32)
Esn=Es/np.linalg.norm(Es,axis=1,keepdims=True)
def ov_scores(M):
    res={}
    for L in range(18):
        W=lambda s: weights[f'{M}.layers.{L}.{s}']
        ln=1+W('input_layernorm.weight'); pa=1+W('post_attention_layernorm.weight')
        V=W('self_attn.v_proj.weight'); O=W('self_attn.o_proj.weight')
        X1=(Esn*ln)@V.T  # 5000x256
        for h in range(4):
            out=(X1@O[:,256*h:256*h+256].T)*pa*fn  # 5000x640
            logits=out@Esn.T
            d=np.diag(logits)
            res[(L,h)]=( (d-logits.mean(1))/logits.std(1) ).mean()
    return res
